items.title: Sherwood Mangiapane Interview, 1959-05-05
items.q: And Mr. O'Keefe, the mayor, would send his son to my house.

ctx.x: Well now, what were the other kind of parties you mentioned? And what did they consist of? What kind of customs?

Well, I think a lot of those parties were little private parties, just things that people gave just for the fun of it, you know. And I can remember also playing for the mayor of the city. And we were so small. In those days, the little boys wore short pants, not like today. As soon as they can walk around, they'd give them a pair of long pants. We had long black stockings and little short pants. And we couldn't get around because we had no transportation. And my mother wouldn't let us go out and play unless…
I think you told me before when I interviewed you without the recorder that Pops Foster influenced your style.
